title: The Things They Carried
author: Tim O'Brien
current_text: In 1992, The Things They Carried was removed from Waukesha classrooms in Wisconsin because of “anti-American attitudes, offensive language, political bias, and disturbing fiction.” In 2000, The Things They Carried was challenged at the Pennridge, Pa. high school over its strong language but was retained. In 2006, a board member raised a controversy over The Things They Carried based on excerpts found on the Internet, but the book was retained on the Northwest Suburban High School District 214 reading list in Arlington Heights, Ill.

O’Brien, Tim. The Things They Carried. Broadway Bks.; Houghton. Retained on the Northwest Suburban High School District 214 reading list in Arlington Heights, Ill. (2006), along with eight other challenged titles. A board member, elected amid promises to bring her Christian beliefs into all board decision-making, raised the controversy based on excerpts from the books she’d found on the Internet.
